meta.title: GIST in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (localized and advanced), adult
meta.population: Adults with GIST - THE TARGETED-THERAPY ORIGINAL: the disease where precision oncology was invented in real time - KIT's gain-of-function discovery (Hirota, Science 1998 - PMID-verified, with two near-title decoys documented), the first imatinib patient (NEJM 2001, verified), and B2222 (verified: 53.7% partial response when advanced GIST had nothing) - and where GENOTYPE IS THE DOSE: exon 11 takes imatinib 400, exon 9 earns 800 (MetaGIST verified - a PFS-only benefit, no OS, said exactly), PDGFRA D842V is imatinib-RESISTANT and takes avapritinib, and SDH-deficient/wild-type disease is the honesty chapter where imatinib underperforms and the NIH clinic is a standing referral. The iceberg honesty is verified: micro-GISTs sit in 22.5% of autopsied stomachs over 50 - most GIST biology never becomes GIST disease - while registry incidence runs 0.70/100,000/yr (the common '5,000-6,000 US cases' figure is an ESTIMATE above registry capture - the briefing's certainty corrected).
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the targeted-therapy original. THE ORIGIN ARC is fully verified: Hirota's five sequenced tumors -> the single-patient NEJM proof -> B2222's 53.7% -> Heinrich's PDGFRA complement (14/40 KIT-negative tumors, mutually exclusive) -> MetaGIST's dose lesson (800mg helps essentially only exon 9, PFS-only - with a 2025-vintage exon-9 adjuvant paper documented as a citation-contamination hazard). THE ADJUVANT CHAPTER is verified both papers deep: SSGXVIII (three years beats one - RFS AND OS) and its 10-year update ('~50% of deaths may be avoided' - verified sni…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: Genotype as the router (KIT exon 11 / exon 9 / PDGFRA D842V / SDH-wild-type - the receipts verified per branch); risk stratification for localized disease by Miettinen/AFIP size-site-mitoses (verified reviews) with Joensuu's modified criteria adding RUPTURE (the validation receipt verified); 'most common mesenchymal tumor of the GI tract' (the verified phrasing - 'commonest sarcoma overall' is convention-grade, said as such)
meta.response: Choi-aware imaging conventions (secondhand) with the ctDNA-era receipt VERIFIED: INTRIGUE's ctDNA analysis (Nature Medicine, PMID-matched) split second-line by secondary-mutation topology - BOTH HALVES taught (the briefing's half was completed): KIT exon 11+17/18 favors ripretinib (mPFS 14.2 vs 1.5 months) AND exon 11+13/14 favors SUNITINIB (15.0 vs 4.0) - a mirror, not a slogan

Newly diagnosed.name: Resection + risk-stratified adjuvant imatinib (localized)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the localized standard (verified adjuvant machinery; genotype-gated)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized adjuvant receipts with OS (verified both papers); figure flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: surgery + three pill-years' ledger (edema, cramps, cytopenias) - adherence the quiet variable
Newly diagnosed.patient: For GIST that surgery can remove: the operation, then - for higher-risk tumors with the right mutation - three years of the targeted pill, which cuts deaths roughly in half over the following decade.
drugs: Resection + adjuvant imatinib x3 years (high-risk, imatinib-sensitive genotypes)

Newly diagnosed.name: Imatinib 400 (advanced, KIT exon 11 - the original's chapter)
Newly diagnosed.patient: For advanced GIST with the commonest mutation: one daily pill - the drug that invented this kind of medicine - controls the disease for years in most people.

Newly diagnosed.name: Imatinib 800 (advanced, KIT exon 9 - the dose the genotype earns)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the exon-9 dose (MetaGIST verified - PFS-only, said)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the doubled dose's heavier ledger - the PFS-only honesty is why tolerance matters
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the exon-9 mutation: the same pill at double dose - the genetic report itself wrote the prescription strength.

Newly diagnosed.name: Avapritinib (advanced, PDGFRA D842V - the resistant exception's own drug)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the D842V standard (journal-cited receipts; scope honest)
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: avapritinib's ledger incl. cognitive effects - the counseling point
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the D842V mutation - which the classic pill cannot touch: a purpose-built pill that shrinks nearly nine in ten of these tumors.

refs.label: THE ORIGIN ARC, verified: Hirota 'Gain-of-function mutations of c-kit in human GIST' (Science 1998 - PMID 9438854, pubmed-url-match: 5 tumors, constitutive activation; THE NEAR-TITLE FAMILY documented: 9797363 and 25080996 could be mis-cited as the original); the first patient (Joensuu, NEJM 2001 - 11287975, matched); B2222 (Demetri, NEJM 2002 - 12181401, matched: n=147, PR 53.7% + SD 27.9% - verified snippet); Heinrich PDGFRA (Science 2003 - 12522257, matched: 14/40 KIT-negative, mutually exclusive). 'Most common mesenchymal tumor of the GI tract' - the verified phrasing | PMID 9438854 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

GENOTYPE IS THE DOSE, verified: MetaGIST 1,640-patient pooled analysis (JCO 2010 - PMID 20124181, pubmed-url-match): the 800mg PFS advantage sits 'essentially among KIT exon 9' with IDENTICAL OS (the PFS-only honesty prints); S0033 phase 3 matched (18235122). THE CONTAMINATION HAZARD documented: a 2025-vintage exon-9 ADJUVANT paper (41746633) could stand in for MetaGIST in careless citation | PMID 20124181 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE ADJUVANT MACHINERY, verified both papers deep: SSGXVIII (JAMA 2012 - PMID 22453568, pubmed-url-match: 3 years beats 1 - RFS AND OS, n=397 high-risk) + the 10-year update (JAMA Oncol 2020 - 32469385, matched: '~50% of deaths may be avoided during first 10 years' - verified snippet); Z9001 (Lancet 2009 - 19303137, matched: the placebo-controlled year); the risk machinery: Miettinen/AFIP reviews (17090188, 17193820, 16625094 - matched; site matters), Joensuu modified criteria (18774375, matched) with RUPTURE validated (21737227, matched); neoadjuvant RTOG 0132 (18942073, matched). Duration frontier: SSG XXII ex-US closed; ImadGIST 6-vs-3 favoring longer (Ann Oncol 2024, secondhand) - evidence-in-motion, never a US door | PMID 22453568 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE ICEBERG + EPI HONESTY, verified: micro-GISTs in 22.5% of autopsied stomachs >50 (Agaimy - PMID 17197927, pubmed-url-match: 1-10mm, all proximal stomach) + the 2.9% series (21658742, matched) + early-gastric management (25031785, matched); registry incidence 0.70/100,000/yr (USCS 2001-2015 - 31037234, matched; era study 25277795: peak 3.06/100k at 70-79; SEER 15654796). THE ESTIMATE-VS-REGISTRY CORRECTION: the '5,000-6,000 US cases/yr' figure is a clinical estimate ABOVE registry capture - presented as estimate, never receipt (the briefing's certainty corrected) | PMID 17197927 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE LADDER, verified rung by rung: sunitinib 2L (Demetri, Lancet 2006 - PMID 17046465, pubmed-url-match); regorafenib 3L (GRID, Lancet 2013 - 23177515, matched: n=199, mPFS 4.8 vs 0.9, HR 0.27 [0.19-0.39] - verified EXACTLY); ripretinib 4L (INVICTUS - LANCET ONCOLOGY 2020, 32511981, matched - the briefing's 'NEJM?' hedge CORRECTED; the famous 6.3-vs-1.0 months NEVER snippet-verified - MEMORY-GRADE, held; FDA approval summary matched: 36485007); RIGHT rechallenge (24140183, matched - THE DECOY documented: 22357253 'Imatinib rechallenge...' 2012 surfaces first and is the wrong paper); secondary-resistance heterogeneity (18623623, matched - the biology beneath the ladder) | PMID 23177515 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25
refs.src: Lancet family (matched; journal corrected; decoy documented)

refs.label: THE MIRROR, taught whole (the briefing's half COMPLETED - the 16th correction-grade catch): INTRIGUE primary (JCO 2022 - PMID 35947817, pubmed-url-match: ripretinib NOT superior 2L; fewer G3/4 TEAEs) + the ctDNA analysis (Nature Medicine 2024 - 38182785, matched: ctDNA in 280/362; KIT exon 11+17/18 -> RIPRETINIB mPFS 14.2 vs 1.5; exon 11+13/14 -> SUNITINIB 15.0 vs 4.0 - BOTH HALVES verified snippet) + final OS (40408605, matched); INSIGHT - the prospective ctDNA-gated follow-on (design 39229786 + results-paper 39907875, both matched). Teaching only the 17/18 half teaches half the decision | PMID 38182785 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

AVAPRITINIB at honest grades: NAVIGATOR primary (Lancet Oncol 2020;21:935-946) - PMID NEVER matched: JOURNAL-CITED; ORR 88% CR 9% in 56 D842V patients (verified-snippet numbers on the unverified PMID - the briefing's '~90%' TRIMMED to 88); long-term matched (33465704); exon-18 pooled matched (34404327); FDA 2020-01 memory-grade. VOYAGER (vs regorafenib, 3L broad): NEGATIVE - DOI-CITED (10.1200/JCO.21.00217; n=476, missed primary PFS - secondhand); the D842V-exception subgroup MEMORY-FLAGGED (not asserted). THE PAPER-FAMILY trap documented (primary/long-term/exon-18 share title fragments) | PMID 32615108 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE WILD-TYPE CHAPTER at honest grades: SDH-deficient receipts VERIFIED (pediatric/adult series 23730622; SDHA-loss IHC 23060355; epigenomic divergence 23550148); the Boikos NIH-clinic molecular-subtypes paper FLAGGED (named in snippets, PMID unmatched); NF1-GIST = THE DECK'S WEAKEST RECEIPT (secondary sources only - said); rogaratinib FGFR result (Nature Medicine 2026, secondhand: ORR 41.7%, mPFS 31.0 - its NCI trial CLOSED); temozolomide MGMT rationale (2021 retrospective ORR 40%, n=5 - secondhand; the UCSD phase 2 status unverified); the NIH Pediatric & Wildtype clinic OPERATING (2026 applications open) | PMID 23730622 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-25

THE REGULATORY ENDGAME (press/abstract-grade - never a scored answer): PEAK (bezuclastinib + sunitinib vs sunitinib, 2L) READ OUT POSITIVE - mPFS 16.5 vs 9.2 months, HR 0.50, ORR 46% vs 26% (ASCO 2026 abstract + press); NDA submitted 2026-04-01, ACCEPTED with PRIORITY REVIEW 2026-05-28, PDUFA 2026-11-30, Breakthrough in hand - the 2L card may be rewritten within months. THE 15th PREMISE CORRECTION: 'Peak/SARC044' was a CONFLATION - SARC044 (NCT06208748) is the SEPARATE SARC phase 2 (bezuclastinib ADDED AFTER sunitinib failure), active-not-recruiting, readout watch

THE SHELF + DESERTS: StrateGIST 1 (winding down, unverified) and StrateGIST FRONTLINE (NCT07585266 - 1L vs imatinib; EXISTENCE-ONLY, high-priority re-check); DCC-3009 master protocol (NCT06630234 - recruiting, MSK/DFCI: the post-ripretinib door); NB003 (NCT04936178 - MSK/Stanford; 3L+ cORR 41.2% abstract-grade; registrational sibling NCT07379047 existence-only); THE-630 TERMINATED 2023 (hand-foot DLTs) - never returns; D842V-post-avapritinib = a NAMED-TRIAL DESERT (mechanistic doors only - said); US adjuvant/perioperative = EMPTY; Alliance/SWOG = no GIST-named trial; ex-US never US doors (olverembatinib China; the China TMZ; SSG XXII)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.

StrateGIST 3 (NCT07218926, GSK): phase 3 - velzatinib (IDRX-42) vs sunitinib, 2L post-imatinib, PFS primary - RECRUITING (US multi-site: UVA, Utah listed) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. THE COLLISION named: a sunitinib comparator racing a 2026-11-30 PDUFA date

INSIGHT (NCT05734105, Deciphera): phase 3 - ripretinib vs sunitinib in ctDNA-SELECTED KIT exon 11+17/18, post-imatinib; est. completion 2027-12 - RECRUITING per 2024/25-vintage sources (Dana-Farber listed) - STALENESS FLAG LOUD (no 2026 confirmation; verify enrollment survived the PEAK readout) - web-verified 2026-08-20, registry re-check due. The first prospectively ctDNA-gated registration attempt in GIST
